Daily Regime Date Defect
nodes.rationale: All observed regime day files have invalid 1970 date semantics, blocking daily regime use until repair or regeneration is documented.

nodes.label: Minute Regime Bars Structurally Readable
nodes.rationale: Minute ETF and index regime bars are structurally coherent, but still require downstream coverage and price sanity validation.

nodes.label: Certification-Aware Short Consumption
nodes.rationale: Short interest consumption must preserve certification flags, limited-window status, ticker reuse, and reference conflict buckets.

nodes.label: Short Volume Scope Limits
nodes.rationale: Short volume is daily short-sale activity evidence inside source scope, not complete consolidated market shorting truth.

nodes.label: Raw Observation Versus Acceptance Semantics
nodes.rationale: The raw trade-row schema and file-level acceptance schema must not be conflated because disagreement with daily or 1m can reflect scale or context rather than intrinsic tape corruption.

nodes.label: Point-in-Time Window Filter
nodes.rationale: Coverage assertions under the <1B> universe must intersect ticker membership with first_seen_date and last_observed_date, not just ticker inclusion.

nodes.label: Schema Policy Registry Validator Model
nodes.rationale: Dataset contracts define semantics, taxonomies classify states, schemas define expected shape, consumption policies define use, registries locate layers, and validators encode minimum checks.

nodes.label: Subblock-Specific Consumption
nodes.rationale: The additional block is accepted as auxiliary but not homogeneous; consumers must follow subblock-specific restrictions before stricter use is enabled.

nodes.label: Economic Return Price View
nodes.rationale: Daily adjusted represents comparable economic continuity for multi-day returns, not raw observed execution, microstructure, or tape truth.

nodes.label: Daily Quality Coverage Axes
nodes.rationale: Daily final semantics combine quality and coverage axes; historical review is contractually recoverable_with_flag unless a later version refines the policy.
